provenance: one live Workers AI request; no dataset/query execution in this script

request.question: How many trips had pickups in January 2024?

response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
response.executableSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "trips" AS "trips" WHERE (("tpep_pickup_datetime" >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01') AND ("tpep_pickup_datetime" < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'))) AS "__result" LIMIT 501
response.rationale: This query counts all trips with pickups in January 2024.
